label: C01 schema
query: SELECT name, engine, total_rows, create_table_query FROM system.tables WHERE database = 'pypi' ORDER BY name FORMAT CSVWithNames

label: C02 coverage
query: SELECT project, min(min_date) AS first_day, max(max_date) AS last_day FROM pypi.pypi_downloads_max_min WHERE project IN ('mcp','agentcrew-ai','databricks-tellr-app','lean-lsp-mcp','pyp6xer-mcp','serena-agent','dartlab','mistral-vibe','octobot','jesse') GROUP BY project ORDER BY project FORMAT CSVWithNames

label: C03 uploads
query: SELECT name AS project, version, min(upload_time) AS first_upload_utc, groupUniqArray(packagetype) AS file_types FROM pypi.projects WHERE name IN ('mcp', 'lean-lsp-mcp') GROUP BY name, version ORDER BY name, first_upload_utc FORMAT CSVWithNames

label: C04 mcp daily totals
query: SELECT date, count AS downloads FROM (SELECT date, sum(count) AS count FROM pypi.pypi_downloads_per_day WHERE project = 'mcp' AND date BETWEEN '2026-01-17' AND '2026-09-25' GROUP BY date) ORDER BY date FORMAT CSVWithNames

label: C05a mcp by version
query: SELECT date, version, sum(count) AS downloads FROM pypi.pypi_downloads_per_day_by_version WHERE project = 'mcp' AND date BETWEEN '2026-03-19' AND '2026-04-29' GROUP BY date, version ORDER BY date, version FORMAT CSVWithNames

label: C05b mcp by version
query: SELECT date, version, sum(count) AS downloads FROM pypi.pypi_downloads_per_day_by_version WHERE project = 'mcp' AND date BETWEEN '2026-01-17' AND '2026-02-27' GROUP BY date, version ORDER BY date, version FORMAT CSVWithNames

label: C05c mcp by version
query: SELECT date, version, sum(count) AS downloads FROM pypi.pypi_downloads_per_day_by_version WHERE project = 'mcp' AND date BETWEEN '2026-06-27' AND '2026-09-25' GROUP BY date, version ORDER BY date, version FORMAT CSVWithNames

label: C06a mcp by installer and type
query: SELECT date, multiIf(version = '1.27.0', '1.27.0', version = '1.26.0', '1.26.0', version = '1.25.0', '1.25.0', version = '1.26.1', '1.26.1', 'other') AS version_class, installer, type, sum(count) AS downloads FROM pypi.pypi_downloads_per_day_by_version_by_installer_by_type WHERE project = 'mcp' AND date BETWEEN '2026-03-19' AND '2026-04-29' GROUP BY date, version_class, installer, type ORDER BY date, version_class, installer, type FORMAT CSVWithNames

label: C06b mcp by installer and type
query: SELECT date, multiIf(version = '1.27.0', '1.27.0', version = '1.26.0', '1.26.0', version = '1.25.0', '1.25.0', version = '1.26.1', '1.26.1', 'other') AS version_class, installer, type, sum(count) AS downloads FROM pypi.pypi_downloads_per_day_by_version_by_installer_by_type WHERE project = 'mcp' AND date BETWEEN '2026-01-17' AND '2026-02-27' GROUP BY date, version_class, installer, type ORDER BY date, version_class, installer, type FORMAT CSVWithNames

label: C07 mcp by ci flag
query: SELECT date, multiIf(version = '1.27.0', '1.27.0', version = '1.26.0', '1.26.0', version = '1.25.0', '1.25.0', version = '1.26.1', '1.26.1', 'other') AS version_class, installer, toString(ci) AS ci, count() AS downloads FROM pypi.pypi WHERE project = 'mcp' AND date BETWEEN '2026-03-19' AND '2026-04-29' GROUP BY date, version_class, installer, ci ORDER BY date, version_class, installer, ci FORMAT CSVWithNames

label: C08 mcp ci flag contrast
query: SELECT date, multiIf(version = '1.27.0', '1.27.0', version = '1.26.0', '1.26.0', version = '1.25.0', '1.25.0', version = '1.26.1', '1.26.1', 'other') AS version_class, toString(ci) AS ci, count() AS downloads FROM pypi.pypi WHERE project = 'mcp' AND date BETWEEN '2026-01-17' AND '2026-02-27' GROUP BY date, version_class, ci ORDER BY date, version_class, ci FORMAT CSVWithNames

label: C09 lean-lsp-mcp
query: SELECT date, version, installer, type, toString(ci) AS ci, count() AS downloads FROM pypi.pypi WHERE project = 'lean-lsp-mcp' AND date BETWEEN '2026-03-19' AND '2026-05-10' GROUP BY date, version, installer, type, ci ORDER BY date, version, installer, type, ci FORMAT CSVWithNames

label: C10 cohort daily totals
query: SELECT date, project, sum(count) AS downloads FROM pypi.pypi_downloads_per_day WHERE project IN ('mcp','agentcrew-ai','databricks-tellr-app','lean-lsp-mcp','pyp6xer-mcp','serena-agent','dartlab','mistral-vibe','octobot','jesse') AND date BETWEEN '2026-03-19' AND '2026-04-29' GROUP BY date, project ORDER BY project, date FORMAT CSVWithNames

label: C11 mcp by file type
query: SELECT date, multiIf(version = '1.27.0', '1.27.0', version = '1.26.0', '1.26.0', version = '1.25.0', '1.25.0', version = '1.26.1', '1.26.1', 'other') AS version_class, type, sum(count) AS downloads FROM pypi.pypi_downloads_per_day_by_version_by_file_type WHERE project = 'mcp' AND date BETWEEN '2026-03-19' AND '2026-04-29' GROUP BY date, version_class, type ORDER BY date, version_class, type FORMAT CSVWithNames

label: C12 mcp before 2024-11-20
query: SELECT toYear(date) AS year, sum(count) AS downloads, min(date) AS first_day, max(date) AS last_day FROM pypi.pypi_downloads_per_day WHERE project = 'mcp' AND date < '2024-11-20' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year FORMAT CSVWithNames
